description: SEC 10-K customer & supplier concentration — Customer concentration risk from a US public company's latest (or earlier, filing 0-4) Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR. Reads the company's own sentences and 10%-customer tables: largest single customer share of revenue, largest customer-group share (top ten etc.), named customers (e.g. Walmart, Apple, Samsung), the 'no customer over 10%' statement, receivables concentration, U.S. government share of sales, and single/sole-source supplier dependence with quotes. Verdict HIGH (one customer 25%+ or a group 60%+) / ELEVATED (10%+ customer, 35%+ group, or 50%+ government) / LOW / NOT_DISCLOSED. Use it for credit and supplier risk, equity research, KYB and M&A screens. ticker: stock ticker or CIK (e.g. NVDA). filing: optional, 0 = latest 10-K (default) up to 4. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
